cues.en: You're good to go? Hello. So, has anyone ever had to use any kind of tabular data? By a show of hands. Okay, a couple people. Has anyone preferred to use the terminal? Okay. And has anyone ever used grep cut aux sort unique with a CSV file?
cues.zh: 准备好了吗？大家好。请问有谁用过表格类的数据吗？举个手看看。好的，有几位。有谁更喜欢用终端吗？好的。那有没有人对 CSV 文件用过 grep、cut、awk、sort、uniq 之类的命令？

cues.en: Okay, right, exactly. Well, I did that way too much and I got kind of fed up with it. So I made a tool called VisiData, which had been working on for the past year on my sabbatical. It's written in Python 3. It's open source. It's in PyPy now. We're working on getting it through an app. It supports a whole lot of formats. Excel files and CSV files and JSON. It's extensible via Python 3. And this is kind of like a Swiss Army chainsaw for data. And this is a lightning demo.
cues.zh: 好的，没错，正是如此。我以前用得实在太多，都快受够了。于是在过去一年的学术休假期间，我做了一个叫 VisiData 的工具。它是用 Python 3 编写的，开源，现在已经上了 PyPI，我们正在努力把它打包进系统软件仓库。它支持大量格式：Excel 文件、CSV 文件以及 JSON。它可以通过 Python 3 进行扩展。这就像是数据处理界的“瑞士军工电锯”。今天是一个快速演示。

cues.en: So, I have a dataset of two months of 311 service complaints from New York, and so it's loading it now. You can see it's loading it asynchronously down there in the corner. You can do all kinds of fun stuff. For instance, you can hide columns with a minus key.
cues.zh: 我这里有一份纽约市两个月的 311 服务投诉数据集，现在正在加载。你可以看到它在角落里异步加载。你可以用它做各种好玩的事情。比如，按减号键就可以隐藏列。

cues.en: If you wanted to, for instance, we have a created date, let me split this based on, this has got a date and time, I just want to see the date, so I just split that, and I've got another column here for just the date. If I wanted to do a frequency analysis on that date, for instance, I would just press Shift F, and here we go, and it tallies it asynchronously, and then if I hide these columns, we can actually make this guy a little bigger here, and you can see the stuff. If we sort by the date, then you can see basic patterns with this simple histogram, right? And so for some reason, there's a,
cues.zh: 如果你想的话，比如我们这里有一个创建日期，让我根据……这里有日期和时间，但我只想看日期，所以直接拆分，这样我就得到了一个只有日期的新列。如果我想对这个日期做频次分析，只需要按 Shift F，看，它正在异步统计；然后如果我把这些列隐藏起来，把这里稍微放大一点，就能看到内容了。如果我们按日期排序，就能通过这个简单的柱状图看出基本规律，对吧？不知道为什么，这里有个……

cues.en: a cycle of like seven days. I don't know, let's see here. So if I type this date column as a date, I'm gonna rename it to create date, and then I can use that as an expression, or in an expression, to make another column. So let's say I just wanted to get the weekday. This is just Python here. And so you can see the weekday, and that was just the date time we just converted to weekday there. And so you can see, okay, right, it's day five and six, which happens to be Saturday and Sunday. That makes sense.
cues.zh: 类似七天的周期。不知道为什么，我们来看看。如果我把这个日期列的类型设为 date，我把它重命名为 create date，然后我就可以把它当作表达式，或者在表达式中使用它来生成另一列。比如我只想获取星期几。这里直接写 Python 就行。你看，星期几就出来了，这只是我们刚刚把 datetime 转换成了星期。你可以看到，没错，是第 5 天和第 6 天，刚好是周六和周日。这很合理。

cues.en: So if I quit out of this then, and I want to do some simple visualizations of this, let's say, there's a bunch of different fields in here, like the latitude and longitude. So let me make these just floats here, because it turns out that latitude and longitude, even though they're on a sphere, you can kind of think of them as X-Y coordinates. So I'm going to make the longitude be an X.
cues.zh: 如果我退出这个界面，想要做一些简单的可视化，比如这里有很多不同的字段，像经度和纬度。我先把它们转成浮点数，因为事实证明，尽管经纬度是在球面上，但你也可以把它们近似看作 X-Y 坐标。所以我要把经度设为 X……

cues.en: coordinate, and actually I'm gonna go get the burrow here. I'll make that be a key column so you can get a little bit of color, and I'm just gonna plot that with dot. This is all in the terminal still, by the way, and so I'm not sure if you guys have ever seen a map of New York. These are the complaints. Thank you. If we wanted to see all the things we had done to get to this point, we could press shift D to get to a command log, and this is all the things that we did in order. If we wanted to, I could actually save this off and replay it later. That took 20 seconds earlier, so I'm not gonna waste that time right now.
cues.zh: 坐标，实际上我还想把行政区（borough）拿过来。我把它设为键值列，这样就能带点颜色，然后我直接按“.”把它画出来。顺便提一下，这全程都还在终端里。不知道大家见没见过纽约地图？这些就是投诉数据。谢谢。如果我们想查看走到这一步所做的所有操作，可以按 Shift D 打开命令日志，这里按顺序记录了我们做过的所有事。如果需要的话，我甚至可以把它保存下来稍后重放。刚才重放花了 20 秒，我现在就不浪费这个时间了。

cues.en: But if we wanted to do some more fun stuff with this, let's say this is a simple map of just the complaints, let's do some more things here. I'm gonna keep the burrow out of there, and oh, here we go, a complaint type. So I'll do a frequency analysis on that, and after that's done here, let's find something interesting. Oh, it's rodents, it's always fun. So I pressed enter just to go to all the rodent complaint types, and then let's see whether rat sightings or mouse sightings or whatever, do the exact same.
cues.zh: 但如果我们想玩点更有意思的，假设这只是投诉的简单地图，那我们再做一些操作。我会把 borough 那列去掉，哦，来了，投诉类型。我对它做频次分析，做完之后，找个有意思的。哦，是啮齿类，这个总是好玩。我按了回车，跳到所有啮齿类投诉类型，然后看看 rat sightings 或 mouse sightings 之类的，是不是完全一样。

cues.en: Plot here and so here's the map of those and if I want to I can turn those layers on and off with the numbers here So you can see only the mouse sightings or only the rat sightings etc bounce back and forth between them if you want to etc And just because I think it's fun You can use the mouse to zoom in for instance on Manhattan And then you can select a region and just press enter to go to just those rows for that and then Thank you
cues.zh: 在这里绘图，这就是它们的地图。如果我想，可以用这里的数字开关这些图层，这样你可以只看 mouse sightings 或只看 rat sightings 等，想的话就在它们之间来回切。而且我觉得挺好玩，你可以用鼠标放大，比如曼哈顿，然后选一个区域，按回车就只跳到对应的那些行，然后，谢谢。

cues.en: And then you can save those off as a CSV file, and that's the very simple workflow with VisiData. Like I said, it's extensible with Python. You can do all kinds of expressions. You can create a VisiData RC with custom functions in there. I have a gender function in there, so anybody's first name, I can just make a column with their supposed gender based on their first name. It's just a great tool if you're ever doing data and just want to do something really quickly before you even know what's even in there.
cues.zh: 然后你可以把这些保存成 CSV 文件，这就是 VisiData 非常简单的流程。就像我说的，它可以用 Python 扩展。你可以做各种表达式。你可以创建一个 VisiData RC，把自定义函数放进去。我里面有个性别函数，所以只要有名，我就能根据名字新建一列，标出推测的性别。如果你做数据，想在还没搞清楚里面有什么之前快速做点东西，这工具很棒。

cues.en: So we're working on releasing 1.0 right after this conference next week. And so if you're interested in this and using this, I would love to give you either more hands-on demo or show how you could help you. So please hit me up after the lightning talks. Anyway, thank you very much.
cues.zh: 我们正努力在下周这个会议结束后发布 1.0。如果你感兴趣并在用这个，我很乐意给你做更实操的演示，或看看怎么帮到你。所以闪电演讲后请来找我。总之，非常感谢。
